title: Commit Secret Guard
description: Stops a credential going into a commit by scanning only the lines a diff adds for provider keys, private keys, passwords in URLs, hard-coded secrets and high-entropy strings, flagging .env and key files, ignoring test fixtures by pattern (except live key formats), and offering per-finding fixes (move to an env variable, remove the line, or mark a false positive) with a rotate-now warning when the change is already pushed.
